announcement.title: 🎨 Landing Page Maker v1.1.0
announcement.content:
Landing Page Maker v1.1.0

  • Duplicate a section with its elements, groups, and layer folders from the section toolbar in either editor. Shared elements remain shared, and undo removes the copy in one step.
  • Use section transitions from Twilight Exposition, Silent Orpheus, Moonless Archive, Signal Archive, and Hangar Seven on any page without changing its theme.
  • Customize transition timing and colors, with image, decoration, and text controls for supported effects. Preview changes, reset a design, and apply settings to the page default or an individual button.
  • Outside Scene Backgrounds now play WebM and other supported videos muted and on loop. Adjust fit, focus, blur, and dim without restarting playback.
